candidate.title: uniqueStable sorts instead of preserving first-occurrence order
acceptance: The test 'deduplication preserves first occurrence order' fails with an AssertionError because uniqueStable returns a sorted array instead of preserving the original first-occurrence order.
The actual output is [ 'ant', 'bird', 'zebra' ] while the expected output is [ 'zebra', 'ant', 'bird' ].
The other two tests ('repeated identical values occur once' and 'empty input remains empty') pass because sorting does not change the result for single-element or empty arrays.
